summary: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path.
takeaways: Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions.
On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures.
Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path.
